newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND UNDER-21 STRIKER BOWYER ON DISORDER CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND UNDER-21 STRIKER BOWYER ON DISORDER CHARGE.

text.p: Police on Monday charged England under-21 striker Lee Bowyer with violent disorder following an early-morning brawl at a fast-food restaurant last week.
The 19-year-old Leeds United player will appear in a magistrates court next month along with two other youths, police said.
They were arrested after an incident at a McDonald's restaurant.
Bowyer, bought by Leeds from Charlton during the close season for 3.5 million pounds ($5.46 million), was on a six-week rest at the time of the incident after eye surgery on a detached retina.
